items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Toots Washington? [INTERVIEWEE] No. Oh, yes, Isidore Washington?

ctx.x: Yes, those with whom I played were all reading musicians. I haven't been with anyone other than reading musicians since I've been a musician.
Did you ever go around and hear Red Caillou or Toots or any of those people that were playing at parties?
No, I don't know Red Caillou.
